brief:
An Israeli military vehicle ran over three Palestinians during an incursion into Ya'bad, west of Jenin in the occupied West Bank, on Tuesday evening, Middle East Eye reported. The incident occurred as Israeli forces entered the town.

The three Palestinians sustained injuries from being struck by the military vehicle. Further details about their condition and the circumstances of the incident were not immediately available.

title: Israeli military vehicle injures three Palestinians in West Bank incursion
